description: This Java class manages external login keys for single sign-on authentication in OFBiz applications, including token generation, validation, cleanup, and user login handling.

classes.name: ExternalLoginKeysManager
classes.description: Manages external login keys for single sign-on authentication, including token creation, validation, and cleanup.

methods.name: getExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an external login token, storing it in session and request attributes, and maintaining a map of active login keys.

methods.name: cleanupExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Removes the external login key from the active map based on session attribute.

methods.name: checkExternalLoginKey
methods.description: Performs user authentication based on external login key parameter, handling login, logout, and session updates.

methods.name: isAjax
methods.description: Checks if the request is an Ajax request based on headers.

methods.name: isExternalLoginKeyEnabled
methods.description: Determines if external login key functionality is enabled based on properties.
